title: Virgo tried to label 1,000 galaxies.
caption: Virgo tried to label a cluster of over a thousand galaxies and ran out of tape at 47. Then Pisces, crying at the view, pointed out the black hole nobody could label. Virgo, what's the last thing you tried to organize?
